item.title: Self-Hosting Immich on EC2, with the Photo Library on S3
item.author: Dudu Twizer
item.description: How I run my own Google Photos: Immich on a Graviton EC2 box, originals on an S3 rclone mount, hot data on EBS, private over Tailscale, with a real Let’s Encrypt cert and zero open ports.
